question.worked_solution:
The Newton-Raphson process for optimization is

$$
{x}_{n+1}={x}_{n}-\frac{{f}^{′}({x}_{n})}{{f}^{″}({x}_{n})},
$$

where ${f}^{′}({x}_{n})$ and ${f}^{″}({x}_{n})$ are the first and second derivatives of $f(x)$ evaluated at ${x}_{n},$ respectively.

In our case, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =({e}^{x}-2x-1)^{′}={e}^{x}-2, \\ {f}^{″}(x) & =({e}^{x}-2)^{′}={e}^{x}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, our Newton-Raphson formula is

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{n+1}={x}_{n}-\frac{{e}^{{x}_{n}}-2}{{e}^{{x}_{n}}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Starting with ${x}_{0}=0,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} & ={x}_{0}-\frac{{e}^{{x}_{0}}-2}{{e}^{{x}_{0}}} \\  & =0.5-\frac{{e}^{0.5}-2}{{e}^{0.5}} \\  & =0.713\,061…\end{aligned}
$$

For the second iteration, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} & ={x}_{1}-\frac{{e}^{{x}_{1}}-2}{{e}^{{x}_{1}}} \\  & =(0.713\,061…)-\frac{{e}^{0.713\,061…}-2}{{e}^{0.713\,061…}} \\  & ≈0.693,\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to three decimal places.
